warmup.description: Prepare hips, knees, and ankles with controlled mobility and activation for squat and hinge patterns.
movements: Hip hinge drill (hands on hips) x 10
Ankle mobility rocks x 10 each side

main_exercises.name: Tempo Bodyweight Squat
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, slow tempo (3 seconds down, 1 pause, controlled up)
main_exercises.form_cue: Sit hips down between heels while keeping chest lifted

main_exercises.name: Hip Hinge Drill (Wall Tap or Dowel)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, focus on patterning rather than fatigue
main_exercises.form_cue: Push hips back while keeping spine neutral and ribs down

main_exercises.name: Split Squat (Bodyweight)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight with controlled depth and balance
main_exercises.form_cue: Lower straight down and keep front knee tracking forward

main_exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, focus on glute activation
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep hips level and avoid arching the lower back

main_exercises.name: Supported Romanian Deadlift (Light Dumbbells optional)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight or very light load, prioritizing hinge control
main_exercises.form_cue: Maintain slight knee bend and feel stretch through hamstrings

cooldown.description: Reinforce mobility and release tension in hips and posterior chain.
movements: Deep squat hold (supported if needed) x 60s

phase_notes.menstrual: This technique-focused session is ideal—move slowly and use it to reconnect with movement patterns without fatigue. Prioritize comfort and range of motion.
phase_notes.follicular: Great time to refine technique—focus on precision in squat and hinge mechanics, building a strong foundation for heavier training later.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Even with higher energy, keep this session controlled—use it to improve movement quality and reinforce strong patterns.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Use this session to maintain consistency and clean technique—focus on smooth, controlled reps rather than intensity.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This low-intensity session is supportive—move gently and focus on control and stability without pushing effort.
